caption: The drawing depicts two vertically oriented teaspoons, side by side, rendered in shades of gray on off-white paper. Both spoons have an oval-shaped bowl and a long handle, with the spoon on the left showing additional detailing: its handle features a fan-shaped decorative element below the bowl and a narrow vertical groove running down the center. The spoon on the right is plainer, with a smooth handle that tapers gently toward the base and no decoration. Both objects are contained within a lightly outlined rectangular border centrally placed on the page. The drawing utilizes shading techniques to illustrate the three-dimensional curvature and metallic surface of the spoons.
title: Pewter Spoon
